conventions.decision: AI full-text eligibility recommendation, distinct from final human/formal inclusion.
conventions.read_extent: Eligibility requires sufficient full-text evidence for every criterion, not independent verification of every proof, appendix or codebase. Inspected extent and version are specified per record.
conventions.features: Only feature_codes fields are verified in this checkpoint. Other legacy feature codes remain provisional. No means not demonstrated in the inspected evidence/version; Partial requires the stated limitation.
conventions.uq: Image UQ includes deterministic sets and posterior variability; it does not imply calibrated probabilities. Operator UQ requires uncertainty for operator parameters, not image variance caused by uncertain physics.
conventions.access: Full texts inspected online or retrieved as local PDFs. Acquisition flags describe this assessment session, not repository distribution. No paper PDFs are committed; links, versions and PDF hashes preserve retrieval provenance.
conventions.c1: Primary research belongs to the unchanged date window. P069 retains its verified 2020 journal lineage while the inspected 2019 precursor is explicitly identified; final-version equivalence is not assumed.
conventions.c5: Every assessed record had an accessible English full text at source_url.
conventions.provenance: No reproducible database search or undocumented discovery date is inferred from this targeted batch.

records.title: Deep Learning for Handling Kernel/Model Uncertainty in Image Deconvolution
records.version: Author-hosted CVPR 2020 manuscript; publisher text not compared.
records.technical: Unrolling compensates for kernel error through an image-dependent residual while retaining the supplied kernel. Tests include synthesized errors and kernels from blind estimators. Ringing comparisons are partial artifact evidence; no physical-kernel posterior or calibrated reliability is demonstrated.
records.applicability: Residual compensation is an existing comparator; transfer tests do not isolate an unseen operator family.
quality_followups: Match kernel-estimator inputs, measurement noise and boundary handling; residual recovery does not identify a physical operator.

records.title: Real-World Blur Dataset for Learning and Benchmarking Deblurring Algorithms
records.version: Author-hosted ECCV 2020 manuscript; publisher text not compared.
records.technical: RealBlur captures paired blurred/sharp images, then aligns, downsamples and denoises targets. Cross-dataset experiments test synthetic-to-real transfer. The main dataset contains static scenes; dynamic-scene examples do not supply equivalent paired evaluation. Real measurements also contain noise.
records.applicability: Useful real-capture benchmark; target preprocessing and scene coverage matter.
quality_followups: Preserve scene-disjoint splits and evaluation alignment; inspect target uncertainty before treating pairs as exact truth.

records.title: Designing a Practical Degradation Model for Deep Blind Image Super-Resolution
records.version: arXiv 2103.14006 v2, 30 September 2021; final ICCV text not compared.
records.technical: BSRGAN randomizes blur, resizing and noise operations, including camera/JPEG effects. Synthetic and unpaired real-image tests examine practical transfer. The network does not explicitly recover an operator. Bubble artifacts and disagreement between quality metrics and visual assessment limit reliability interpretation.
records.applicability: Practical degradation training is established; transfer is not a controlled unseen-family experiment.
quality_followups: Match training data, losses and degradation distributions; shared architecture alone does not isolate the training contribution.

records.title: Pseudoinverse-Guided Diffusion Models for Inverse Problems
records.version: Author-hosted PDF marked published at ICLR 2023.
records.technical: ΠGDM approximates measurement-conditioned diffusion scores using supplied operators and pseudoinverses, including nonlinear examples. Compound tasks and pooling-to-bicubic comparisons are evaluated. Image posterior sampling earns P=Yes; it does not infer operator uncertainty or demonstrate calibrated coverage.
records.applicability: Operator-aware generative baseline with known measurement maps, not blind physical estimation.
quality_followups: Match class-label access and sampling cost; inspect inverse-composition and Gaussian-approximation assumptions.

records.title: Zero-Shot Image Restoration Using Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Model
records.version: arXiv 2212.00490 v2, 7 December 2022; final ICLR 2023 text not compared.
records.technical: DDNM constrains the range-space component using a supplied linear operator. DDNM+ handles noise and composed old-photo tasks with manually specified masks/noise settings. Its real-image treatment approximates nonlinear corruption; consistency alone does not verify generated null-space detail.
records.applicability: Separates data consistency from correctness; image-UQ coding is left provisional.
quality_followups: Compare final text, operator approximation and manual inputs; the inspected version does not calibrate sampled detail.

records.title: DiffBIR: Toward Blind Image Restoration with Generative Diffusion Prior
records.version: arXiv 2308.15070 v3, 12 April 2024; final ECCV text not compared.
records.technical: DiffBIR combines task-specific restorers with diffusion conditioning. Region-adaptive guidance follows the restored image, rather than an estimated physical operator. Compound/real-image tests and distortion ablations provide partial artifact evidence. Guidance is disabled in reported real-world comparisons.
records.applicability: Fidelity guidance differs from calibrated abstention; image-UQ coding remains provisional.
quality_followups: Match task-specific restorers and total compute; do not infer coverage from guidance or no-reference quality scores.

records.title: SR+Codec: a Benchmark of Super-Resolution for Video Compression Bitrate Reduction
records.version: BMVC 2024 official proceedings PDF inspected through the web reader.
records.technical: SR+Codec benchmarks pretrained SR after downsampling and codec compression. Low-complexity source videos intentionally limit other corruption. Synthetic acquisition from natural footage is not captured CCTV degradation. Human preference and metric correlation do not establish uncertainty calibration.
records.applicability: Relevant compression comparator; temporal operator variation was not evaluated.
quality_followups: Audit codec settings and LPIPS-based model shortlisting; validate the combined quality metric on independent data.

records.title: The Troublesome Kernel: On Hallucinations, No Free Lunches, and the Accuracy-Stability Tradeoff in Inverse Problems
records.version: arXiv 2001.01258 v4, 18 June 2024; final SIAM Review text not compared.
records.read_extent: §3; §§4.1–4.3 through Theorem 4.5/discussion; §6; Appendix A.1–A.3 selected examples. Proofs not audited.
records.technical: The theory links near-null measurement directions to accuracy/stability conflicts and hallucinations under stated linear-operator assumptions. Microscopy/MRI examples and inserted-detail tests support distinct empirical cases. These are conditional results, not universal claims that every reconstruction must hallucinate.
records.applicability: A theory comparator; measured microscopy and simulated examples must remain distinguished.
quality_followups: Check final theorem hypotheses before extending conclusions to nonlinear CCTV; small residuals are not detail certificates.

records.title: Blind Image Deconvolution Using Deep Generative Priors
records.version: arXiv v4, 26 February 2019; linked IEEE TCI journal report dated 2020. Final text not compared.
records.technical: Alternating latent optimization jointly estimates an image and blur kernel. Generator-range limitations and noise transfer are tested; all acquisition experiments are synthetic. Random restarts select point estimates, not operator posteriors. VAE prior training does not itself provide inverse-problem calibration.
records.applicability: Early joint-generative comparator; noise-transfer evidence is narrower than operator-family transfer.
quality_followups: Separate tests on generator-range images from arbitrary targets and reconcile the 2019 manuscript with the 2020 report.

records.title: Exploiting Diffusion Prior for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
records.version: arXiv 2305.07015 v4, 28 June 2024; expanded journal-style manuscript. Final IJCV text not compared.
records.read_extent: §§3.1–3.3; §§4.1–4.3 selected comparisons; §4 ablation excerpts; Appendices A–C.
records.technical: StableSR conditions a fixed diffusion prior with a time-aware encoder and optional fidelity control. Synthetic and captured-image benchmarks assess compound restoration. Severe-degradation examples motivate pre-cleaning. Fidelity control and visual preference provide no calibrated rule for withholding unsupported detail.
records.applicability: Diffusion timesteps are not temporal video degradation; image-UQ coding remains provisional.
quality_followups: Reconcile the user-study sample-count inconsistency and final version; separate optional pre-cleaning/CFW settings in comparisons.
